title: What Is Artex? The AI Hacking Tool Linked to the US Spy Agency Breach
summary: Microsoft says state-backed hackers and cybercriminals are using Artex to automate attacks with AI agents, exploiting familiar security flaws at speeds that leave defenders little time to respond or recover.

title: The 1Password Breach Didn’t Touch Your Vault. The Phishing Emails Might

summary: Two AI models on one vLLM inference server traded secret messages through GPU kernel rounding errors, with no network or shared files.

title: UK Regulator Cites Binance Hack as It Plans Tougher DeFi Rules Than US and EU: Report
summary: The FCA plans to require DeFi platforms to be authorized and to keep regulated exchanges from routing UK retail trades to them.

title: Cyprus Becomes Espionage Target for Iranian Hackers
